comment: The SRC knob is configured over 1 to 5 on this module too (SickoLooper5.cpp:475-482), which matches its five sources. The bar displays, the BPM and meter displays are custom widgets with no ParamWidget, so the track menus they carry cannot be reached by clicking them for help; the same items are on the module's own menu under Tracks settings. Unlike sickoLooper1 this module has SOLO buttons, EAR and MASTER outputs and preset files, and it has no V/Oct, PAN CV, VOL CV or REV trigger inputs and no CLICK or RST output.
